title: Chain Discriminant
summary: Per-network 16-bit value reused as the IH58 network prefix so account addresses self-identify their Sora Nexus chain and avoid cross-network collisions.
definition: Per-network 16-bit value reused as the IH58 network prefix so account addresses self-identify their Sora Nexus chain and avoid cross-network collisions.
tagline: The numeric network prefix embedded in IH58 addresses.
